Generating Station (PWGS). The PWGS is a nominal 1,150-megawatt natural gas-fired, combined cycle electric
generating station. The facility consists of two (2) similar combined cycle electric generating units or power blocks
arranged in a “2 x 1” configuration, meaning that each combined cycle unit consists of two (2) natural gas-fired
combustion turbine generators (CT) and one steam turbine electric generator. Each CT is equipped with a heat
recovery steam generator (HRSG) which provides steam to the steam turbine electric generator common to that unit.
